## Checkbox (`checkbox`)

Checkbox built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add checkbox`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/checkbox.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Checkbox as BaseCheckbox } from '@base-ui/react/checkbox';
import { type HTMLMotionProps, motion } from 'motion/react';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { transitions, useControlTransition } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn, type RadiusProps, radiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

export function Checkbox({
  className,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseCheckbox.Root> & RadiusProps) {
  const transition = useControlTransition();

  return (
    <BaseCheckbox.Root
      className={cn(
        'flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center border border-input bg-background outline-none transition-colors',
        'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        'data-[checked]:border-primary data-[checked]:bg-primary data-[checked]:text-primary-foreground',
        'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        radiusVariants({ radius }),
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {/*
        `keepMounted` so the tick can animate both ways. Without it Base UI drops
        the indicator from the DOM the moment the box is unticked, and there's
        nothing left to animate out.
      */}
      <BaseCheckbox.Indicator
        keepMounted
        className="flex text-current"
        render={(indicatorProps, state) => (
          <motion.span
            {...(indicatorProps as HTMLMotionProps<'span'>)}
            initial={false}
            animate={{ opacity: state.checked ? 1 : 0, scale: state.checked ? 1 : 0.6 }}
            transition={transition}
          >
            <svg
              viewBox="0 0 16 16"
              className="size-3.5"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth={3}
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              {/* The tick draws itself on rather than just fading in. */}
              <motion.path
                d="M3 8l3.5 3.5L13 4"
                strokeLinecap="square"
                initial={false}
                animate={{ pathLength: state.checked ? 1 : 0 }}
                transition={state.checked ? transitions.enter : transitions.exit}
              />
            </svg>
          </motion.span>
        )}
      />
    </BaseCheckbox.Root>
  );
}
````

## Code (`code`)

Single-line or multi-line code snippet with an optional title strip, syntax highlighting and a copy button. Plain styled container — not a Base UI primitive.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add code`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`, `class-variance-authority`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `highlight`

### `src/ui/code.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Button as BaseButton } from '@base-ui/react/button';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { type HTMLMotionProps, motion } from 'motion/react';
import * as React from 'react';

import { type Language, type TokenKind, tokenize } from '@/lib/highlight';
import { useTapMotion } from '@/lib/motion';
import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

const codeVariants = cva('flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden font-mono font-bold', {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      default: 'border-l-[3px] border-l-primary bg-primary/[0.06] text-foreground',
      outline: 'border border-border border-l-[3px] border-l-primary bg-background text-primary',
      muted: 'border-l-[3px] border-l-border bg-muted text-foreground',
      ghost: 'border-l-[3px] border-l-transparent bg-transparent text-foreground'
    },
    size: {
      sm: 'text-xs',
      default: 'text-sm',
      lg: 'text-base'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    variant: 'default',
    size: 'default'
  }
});

/**
 * How each size packs its rows. Separate from the cva above, which only sets the
 * type scale and the box's colours — these are the metrics the header, the snippet
 * row and the copy button have to agree on.
 *
 *  header  the title strip, deliberately tighter than the snippet row
 *  row     the snippet row
 *  inset   tightens whichever row holds the copy button, since the button carries
 *          its own optical padding around the icon
 *  button  the button box; the negative margin lets a button taller than the line
 *          it sits on bleed into the row's padding instead of growing the row
 *  label   the title's own type scale — meta text, a step down from the code
 */
const SIZES = {
  sm: {
    header: 'px-2.5 py-1',
    row: 'gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5',
    inset: 'pr-1',
    button: '-my-1 size-6 [&_svg]:size-3.5',
    label: 'text-[0.6875rem]'
  },
  default: {
    header: 'px-3 py-1.5',
    row: 'gap-2 px-3 py-2',
    inset: 'pr-1.5',
    button: '-my-1 size-7 [&_svg]:size-4',
    label: 'text-xs'
  },
  lg: {
    header: 'px-4 py-2',
    row: 'gap-2.5 px-4 py-3',
    inset: 'pr-2',
    button: '-my-1 size-8 [&_svg]:size-4.5',
    label: 'text-sm'
  }
} as const;

/**
 * `whitespace-pre` is the whole difference between the two modes: a block keeps
 * its line breaks, and a one-liner is forbidden from wrapping — it scrolls
 * sideways instead, so the row keeps its height and the copy button never moves.
 */
const CONTENT = 'min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre';

const HEADER = 'flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border';

/**
 * Token colours. Three inks and no more, defined in the theme: the house blue for
 * language keywords, a violet for names, a green for literals. Comments and
 * punctuation recede into grey, and anything unclassified stays ink.
 */
const TOKEN_CLASS: Record<TokenKind, string> = {
  plain: '',
  comment: 'font-normal text-muted-foreground',
  keyword: 'text-syntax-keyword',
  literal: 'text-syntax-literal',
  name: 'text-syntax-name',
  punctuation: 'text-muted-foreground'
};

/**
 * The confirmed state borrows --syntax-keyword rather than --primary: it's the
 * same house blue in light mode, but lifted in dark, where #0047ff as a 16px icon
 * on black sits at about 2.3:1.
 */
const COPY_BUTTON =
  'inline-flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center border border-transparent text-current transition-colors outline-none hover:bg-foreground/10 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-inset disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 data-[copied]:text-syntax-keyword [&_svg]:shrink-0';

function CopyIcon() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M11.5 6V2.5H2.5v9H6" />
      <rect x="6" y="6" width="7.5" height="7.5" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function CheckIcon() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M3 8.5 6.5 12 13 4.5" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export interface CodeCopyButtonProps extends Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseButton>, 'children'> {
  /** Text to copy. Falls back to the text content of `target`. */
  code?: string;
  /** Element whose text content is copied when `code` isn't given. */
  target?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  /** Called with the text that reached the clipboard. Not called on a failed write. */
  onCopied?: (code: string) => void;
  /**
   * Accessible name.
   * @default 'Copy code'
   */
  label?: string;
  /**
   * Accessible name and announcement once the text is on the clipboard.
   * @default 'Copied'
   */
  copiedLabel?: string;
  /**
   * How long the confirmation state stays on screen, in ms.
   * @default 2000
   */
  copiedDuration?: number;
}

/**
 * Copy-to-clipboard button. Rendered inside {@link Code} by default; export is
 * for placing one somewhere else — a card header, a table row — against a
 * `target` element or an explicit `code` string.
 */
export function CodeCopyButton({
  className,
  code,
  target,
  onCopied,
  label = 'Copy code',
  copiedLabel = 'Copied',
  copiedDuration = 2000,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: CodeCopyButtonProps) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);
  const tap = useTapMotion();

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!copied) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), copiedDuration);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [copied, copiedDuration]);

  async function writeToClipboard() {
    const text = code ?? target?.current?.textContent ?? '';
    if (!text) return;

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard writes are refused outside a secure context, and under some
      // permission policies. Leave the button alone rather than confirm a copy
      // that never landed.
      return;
    }

    setCopied(true);
    onCopied?.(text);
  }

  return (
    <BaseButton
      aria-label={copied ? copiedLabel : label}
      data-copied={copied || undefined}
      className={cn(COPY_BUTTON, className)}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onClick?.(event);
        void writeToClipboard();
      }}
      render={(buttonProps) => <motion.button {...(buttonProps as HTMLMotionProps<'button'>)} {...tap} />}
      {...props}
    >
      {copied ? <CheckIcon /> : <CopyIcon />}
      {/* A swapped aria-label isn't announced on a button that already has focus. */}
      <span aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
        {copied ? copiedLabel : ''}
      </span>
    </BaseButton>
  );
}

export interface CodeProps
  extends React.ComponentProps<'div'>,
    VariantProps<typeof codeVariants>,
    ContainerRadiusProps {
  /**
   * Text handed to the clipboard. Defaults to the rendered text content, so it
   * only needs setting when the children aren't the literal snippet — a
   * highlighted or truncated rendering, say.
   */
  code?: string;
  /**
   * Filename or label for the snippet, shown in a strip above it. The copy button
   * moves up into that strip, off the code itself.
   */
  title?: string;
  /**
   * Colour the snippet's syntax. Only applies to plain-string children: there's
   * nothing to tokenize in an already-rendered tree, so pass a string and let this
   * do the highlighting, or pass your own spans and leave it off.
   */
  language?: Language;
  /**
   * Render as a block that keeps its line breaks. Inferred from the snippet when
   * left unset: anything with a newline in it becomes a block, a one-liner stays
   * a single row. Set it explicitly when the children aren't a plain string.
   */
  multiline?: boolean;
  /**
   * Show the copy button.
   * @default true
   */
  copy?: boolean;
  /** Called with the text that reached the clipboard. */
  onCopied?: (code: string) => void;
}

/**
 * A command, token or snippet, with a copy button and optional syntax colouring.
 * Plain styled container — not a Base UI primitive.
 */
export function Code({
  className,
  variant,
  size,
  radius,
  code,
  title,
  language,
  multiline,
  copy = true,
  onCopied,
  children,
  ...props
}: CodeProps) {
  const contentRef = React.useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const setContentRef = (element: HTMLElement | null) => {
    contentRef.current = element;
  };

  const source = typeof children === 'string' ? children : undefined;
  const block = multiline ?? (code ?? source)?.includes('\n') ?? false;
  const metrics = SIZES[size ?? 'default'];

  const tokens = React.useMemo(
    () => (language && source !== undefined ? tokenize(source, language) : undefined),
    [language, source]
  );

  // Plain runs stay bare strings: fewer elements, and the copy button reads the
  // same text content either way.
  const content = tokens
    ? tokens.map((token) =>
        token.kind === 'plain' ? (
          token.value
        ) : (
          <span key={token.start} className={TOKEN_CLASS[token.kind]}>
            {token.value}
          </span>
        )
      )
    : children;

  const copyButton = copy ? (
    <CodeCopyButton
      code={code}
      target={contentRef}
      onCopied={onCopied}
      label={title ? `Copy ${title}` : undefined}
      className={metrics.button}
    />
  ) : null;

  return (
    <div
      data-multiline={block || undefined}
      className={cn(codeVariants({ variant, size }), containerRadiusVariants({ radius }), className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {title ? (
        <div className={cn(HEADER, metrics.header, copy && metrics.inset)}>
          <span className={cn('truncate text-foreground', metrics.label)}>{title}</span>
          {copyButton}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div
        className={cn(
          'flex min-w-0',
          // A one-liner centres its copy button against the single row of text; a
          // block pins it to the first line so it stays put as the snippet grows.
          block ? 'items-start' : 'items-center',
          metrics.row,
          !title && copy && metrics.inset
        )}
      >
        {block ? (
          <pre ref={setContentRef} className={CONTENT}>
            <code>{content}</code>
          </pre>
        ) : (
          <code ref={setContentRef} className={CONTENT}>
            {content}
          </code>
        )}
        {title ? null : copyButton}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Stacked snippets — a run of one-liners read as a sequence to type in order. */
export function CodeStack({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return <div className={cn('grid w-full gap-2', className)} {...props} />;
}

export { codeVariants };
````

## Collapsible (`collapsible`)

Collapsible built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add collapsible`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/collapsible.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Collapsible as BaseCollapsible } from '@base-ui/react/collapsible';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

const collapsibleVariants = cva('', {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      default: 'border border-border',
      ghost: 'border-none bg-transparent'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    variant: 'default'
  }
});

export interface CollapsibleProps
  extends React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseCollapsible.Root>,
    VariantProps<typeof collapsibleVariants> {}

export function Collapsible({ className, variant, ...props }: CollapsibleProps) {
  return <BaseCollapsible.Root className={cn(collapsibleVariants({ variant }), className)} {...props} />;
}

export function CollapsibleTrigger({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseCollapsible.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <BaseCollapsible.Trigger
      className={cn(
        'flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-wide outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        '[&>svg]:transition-transform [&[data-panel-open]>svg]:rotate-180',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 16 16"
        className="size-4 shrink-0"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth={2}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <path d="M4 6l4 4 4-4" />
      </svg>
    </BaseCollapsible.Trigger>
  );
}

export function CollapsiblePanel({
  className,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseCollapsible.Panel> & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  return (
    <BaseCollapsible.Panel
      className={cn(
        // CSS rather than Motion, for the reason spelled out in accordion.tsx:
        // Base UI unmounts this panel when its CSS transition ends, and Motion's
        // animations start too late to be seen by that check.
        'h-[var(--collapsible-panel-height)] overflow-hidden text-sm text-muted-foreground',
        'transition-[height,opacity] duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none',
        'data-[starting-style]:h-0 data-[starting-style]:opacity-0',
        'data-[ending-style]:h-0 data-[ending-style]:opacity-0',
        containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { collapsibleVariants };
````

## Combobox (`combobox`)

Combobox built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add combobox`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/combobox.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Combobox as BaseCombobox } from '@base-ui/react/combobox';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import {
  type ContainerRadiusProps,
  cn,
  containerRadiusVariants,
  contentRadiusStyle,
  NESTED_RADIUS,
  type RadiusProps,
  radiusVariants
} from '@/lib/utils';

export const Combobox = BaseCombobox.Root;
export const ComboboxValue = BaseCombobox.Value;

export function ComboboxInput({
  className,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseCombobox.Input> & RadiusProps) {
  return (
    <BaseCombobox.Input
      className={cn(
        'flex h-10 w-full border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        radiusVariants({ radius }),
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function ComboboxContent({
  className,
  children,
  sideOffset = 4,
  radius,
  style,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseCombobox.Popup> & { sideOffset?: number } & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  // A results list appearing under an input: no scale, it would look like a
  // zoom on text the user is actively reading. Just a short slide and fade.
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender({ scale: 1, offset: 6 });

  return (
    <BaseCombobox.Portal>
      <BaseCombobox.Positioner sideOffset={sideOffset} className="z-50">
        <BaseCombobox.Popup
          // Publishes `--content-radius` so items can stay concentric with the popup.
          style={{ ...contentRadiusStyle(radius), ...style }}
          className={cn(
            'max-h-64 min-w-[var(--anchor-width)] overflow-y-auto border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_var(--color-foreground)] outline-none',
            containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          <BaseCombobox.Empty className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground empty:p-0">
            No results.
          </BaseCombobox.Empty>
          <BaseCombobox.List>{children}</BaseCombobox.List>
        </BaseCombobox.Popup>
      </BaseCombobox.Positioner>
    </BaseCombobox.Portal>
  );
}

export function ComboboxItem({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseCombobox.Item>) {
  return (
    <BaseCombobox.Item
      className={cn(
        'flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none data-[highlighted]:bg-foreground data-[highlighted]:text-background',
        NESTED_RADIUS,
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <BaseCombobox.ItemIndicator>✓</BaseCombobox.ItemIndicator>
    </BaseCombobox.Item>
  );
}
````

## Context Menu (`context-menu`)

Context Menu built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add context-menu`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/context-menu.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { ContextMenu as BaseContextMenu } from '@base-ui/react/context-menu';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants, contentRadiusStyle, NESTED_RADIUS } from '@/lib/utils';

export const ContextMenu = BaseContextMenu.Root;
export const ContextMenuTrigger = BaseContextMenu.Trigger;
export const ContextMenuGroup = BaseContextMenu.Group;

export function ContextMenuContent({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  style,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseContextMenu.Popup> & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  // Anchored to the pointer, so it grows from the click point with no slide.
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender({ scale: 0.95, offset: 0 });

  return (
    <BaseContextMenu.Portal>
      <BaseContextMenu.Positioner className="z-50 outline-none">
        <BaseContextMenu.Popup
          style={{ ...contentRadiusStyle(radius), ...style }}
          className={cn(
            'min-w-40 border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_var(--color-foreground)] outline-none',
            '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
            containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </BaseContextMenu.Popup>
      </BaseContextMenu.Positioner>
    </BaseContextMenu.Portal>
  );
}

export function ContextMenuItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseContextMenu.Item>) {
  return (
    <BaseContextMenu.Item
      className={cn(
        'flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none',
        NESTED_RADIUS,
        'data-[highlighted]:bg-foreground data-[highlighted]:text-background',
        'data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-40',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function ContextMenuSeparator({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return <div className={cn('-mx-1 my-1 h-px bg-border', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

## Dialog (`dialog`)

Dialog built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add dialog`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/dialog.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Dialog as BaseDialog } from '@base-ui/react/dialog';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useMotionBackdropRender, useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants, type ShadowProps, shadowVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

export const Dialog = BaseDialog.Root;
export const DialogTrigger = BaseDialog.Trigger;
export const DialogClose = BaseDialog.Close;
export const DialogPortal = BaseDialog.Portal;

export function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  shadow,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseDialog.Popup> & ContainerRadiusProps & ShadowProps) {
  const renderBackdrop = useMotionBackdropRender();
  // A dialog has no anchor to grow from, so it scales in place rather than sliding.
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender({ scale: 0.97, offset: 0 });

  return (
    <BaseDialog.Portal>
      <BaseDialog.Backdrop className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-foreground/40" render={renderBackdrop} />
      <BaseDialog.Popup
        className={cn(
          // Tailwind centres with the standalone `translate` property, which
          // composes with the `transform` Motion writes — they don't collide.
          'fixed left-1/2 top-1/2 z-50 grid w-full max-w-md -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-4',
          'border border-border bg-background p-6 outline-none',
          shadowVariants({ shadow }),
          containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
          className
        )}
        render={renderPopup}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </BaseDialog.Popup>
    </BaseDialog.Portal>
  );
}

export function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return <div className={cn('flex flex-col gap-1', className)} {...props} />;
}

export function DialogFooter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return <div className={cn('flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end', className)} {...props} />;
}

export function DialogTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseDialog.Title>) {
  return <BaseDialog.Title className={cn('text-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-tight', className)} {...props} />;
}

export function DialogDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseDialog.Description>) {
  return <BaseDialog.Description className={cn('text-sm text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

## Data Table (`data-table`)

Generic TanStack table with sorting, global filtering, pagination, page-size controls, and row selection.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add data-table`
- npm dependencies: `@tanstack/react-table@^8.21.3`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `button`, `checkbox`, `input`, `select`

### `src/ui/data-table.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import {
  type ColumnDef,
  flexRender,
  getCoreRowModel,
  getFilteredRowModel,
  getPaginationRowModel,
  getSortedRowModel,
  type OnChangeFn,
  type RowSelectionState,
  type SortingState,
  type TableOptions,
  useReactTable
} from '@tanstack/react-table';
import { useState } from 'react';

import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/ui/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/ui/checkbox';
import { Input } from '@/ui/input';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/ui/select';

export interface DataTableProps<TData> extends ContainerRadiusProps {
  columns: ColumnDef<TData>[];
  data: TData[];
  className?: string;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  initialPageSize?: number;
  pageSizeOptions?: number[];
  enableRowSelection?: boolean;
  getRowId?: TableOptions<TData>['getRowId'];
  onRowSelectionChange?: OnChangeFn<RowSelectionState>;
}

export function DataTable<TData>({
  columns,
  data,
  className,
  radius,
  searchPlaceholder = 'Search...',
  emptyMessage = 'No results.',
  initialPageSize = 10,
  pageSizeOptions = [10, 20, 50],
  enableRowSelection = true,
  getRowId,
  onRowSelectionChange
}: DataTableProps<TData>) {
  const [sorting, setSorting] = useState<SortingState>([]);
  const [globalFilter, setGlobalFilter] = useState('');
  const [rowSelection, setRowSelection] = useState<RowSelectionState>({});

  const selectionColumn: ColumnDef<TData> = {
    id: 'select',
    enableHiding: false,
    enableSorting: false,
    header: ({ table }) => (
      <Checkbox
        aria-label="Select all rows on page"
        checked={table.getIsAllPageRowsSelected()}
        indeterminate={table.getIsSomePageRowsSelected()}
        onCheckedChange={(checked) => table.toggleAllPageRowsSelected(Boolean(checked))}
      />
    ),
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <Checkbox
        aria-label="Select row"
        checked={row.getIsSelected()}
        disabled={!row.getCanSelect()}
        onCheckedChange={(checked) => row.toggleSelected(Boolean(checked))}
      />
    )
  };

  const table = useReactTable({
    data,
    columns: enableRowSelection ? [selectionColumn, ...columns] : columns,
    state: { sorting, globalFilter, rowSelection },
    initialState: { pagination: { pageSize: initialPageSize } },
    enableRowSelection,
    getRowId,
    onSortingChange: setSorting,
    onGlobalFilterChange: setGlobalFilter,
    onRowSelectionChange: (updater) => {
      setRowSelection(updater);
      onRowSelectionChange?.(updater);
    },
    getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
    getFilteredRowModel: getFilteredRowModel(),
    getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
    getPaginationRowModel: getPaginationRowModel()
  });

  return (
    <div className={cn('space-y-3', className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Input
          type="search"
          value={globalFilter}
          onChange={(event) => setGlobalFilter(event.target.value)}
          placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
          aria-label={searchPlaceholder}
          className="max-w-sm"
        />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <span>Rows per page</span>
          <Select
            value={String(table.getState().pagination.pageSize)}
            onValueChange={(value) => table.setPageSize(Number(value))}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="h-8 w-20" aria-label="Rows per page">
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {pageSizeOptions.map((size) => (
                <SelectItem key={size} value={String(size)}>
                  {size}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={cn('overflow-x-auto border border-border bg-background', containerRadiusVariants({ radius }))}>
        <table className="w-full border-collapse text-sm">
          <thead className="bg-muted text-left">
            {table.getHeaderGroups().map((headerGroup) => (
              <tr key={headerGroup.id} className="border-b border-border">
                {headerGroup.headers.map((header) => (
                  <th key={header.id} className="h-11 whitespace-nowrap px-3 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide">
                    {header.isPlaceholder ? null : header.column.getCanSort() ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                        onClick={header.column.getToggleSortingHandler()}
                      >
                        {flexRender(header.column.columnDef.header, header.getContext())}
                        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {header.column.getIsSorted() === 'asc'
                            ? '^'
                            : header.column.getIsSorted() === 'desc'
                              ? 'v'
                              : '-'}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      flexRender(header.column.columnDef.header, header.getContext())
                    )}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {table.getRowModel().rows.length > 0 ? (
              table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
                <tr
                  key={row.id}
                  data-state={row.getIsSelected() ? 'selected' : undefined}
                  className="border-b border-border transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-muted/50 data-[state=selected]:bg-muted"
                >
                  {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
                    <td key={cell.id} className="h-12 whitespace-nowrap px-3">
                      {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
                    </td>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={table.getVisibleLeafColumns().length} className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  {emptyMessage}
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
          {enableRowSelection
            ? `${table.getFilteredSelectedRowModel().rows.length} of ${table.getFilteredRowModel().rows.length} row(s) selected`
            : `${table.getFilteredRowModel().rows.length} row(s)`}
        </span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="mr-2 text-muted-foreground">
            Page {table.getState().pagination.pageIndex + 1} of {Math.max(table.getPageCount(), 1)}
          </span>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            aria-label="First page"
            disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}
            onClick={() => table.firstPage()}
          >
            {'<<'}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            aria-label="Previous page"
            disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}
            onClick={() => table.previousPage()}
          >
            {'<'}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            aria-label="Next page"
            disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}
            onClick={() => table.nextPage()}
          >
            {'>'}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            aria-label="Last page"
            disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}
            onClick={() => table.lastPage()}
          >
            {'>>'}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## Drawer (`drawer`)

Drawer built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add drawer`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/drawer.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Drawer as BaseDrawer } from '@base-ui/react/drawer';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

/**
 * Base UI dismisses a drawer along `swipeDirection`, which defaults to `'down'`.
 * This drawer is styled as a right-hand panel, so the default would have the user
 * swiping down to dismiss a sheet that slides in horizontally, and would leave the
 * backdrop's swipe-progress fade inert — Base UI only reports movement along the
 * configured axis. Override it if you restyle the drawer to enter from another edge.
 */
export function Drawer({ swipeDirection = 'right', ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseDrawer.Root>) {
  return <BaseDrawer.Root swipeDirection={swipeDirection} {...props} />;
}

export const DrawerTrigger = BaseDrawer.Trigger;
export const DrawerClose = BaseDrawer.Close;

export function DrawerContent({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseDrawer.Popup> & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  return (
    <BaseDrawer.Portal>
      <BaseDrawer.Backdrop
        className={cn(
          'fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-foreground/40',
          // Base UI reports how far through a dismiss swipe the drawer is, as a
          // 0–1 scalar. Feeding it into opacity lets the scrim lift under the
          // finger instead of holding full strength until release.
          'opacity-[calc(1-var(--drawer-swipe-progress,0))]',
          'transition-opacity duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)]',
          'data-[starting-style]:opacity-0 data-[ending-style]:opacity-0',
          'data-[swiping]:transition-none'
        )}
      />
      {/*
        The viewport is required, not optional decoration: without it Base UI
        disables swipe-to-close and touch scroll locking outright, which would
        make the swipe-tracking styles below dead code.
      */}
      <BaseDrawer.Viewport className="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 flex">
        <BaseDrawer.Popup
          className={cn(
            'flex w-80 max-w-[90vw] flex-col gap-4 border-l border-border bg-background p-6 outline-none',
            // Drawer motion is CSS rather than Motion, and deliberately so: during a
            // swipe Base UI drives this element by writing `transform` directly, so
            // a `motion.div` — which owns `transform` — would stop the sheet
            // tracking the finger. See lib/motion.tsx for where Motion is used.
            //
            // Enter and exit are ours to animate, via `translate`. Base UI's drag
            // uses `transform`, and Tailwind compiles `translate-*` to the separate
            // `translate` property, so the two never overwrite each other. Don't add
            // `--drawer-swipe-movement-*` here: Base UI already applies that
            // movement itself, and reapplying it moves the drawer twice as far.
            'transition-[translate] duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none',
            'data-[starting-style]:[translate:100%_0] data-[ending-style]:[translate:100%_0]',
            // No easing while the finger is down — the sheet must track it 1:1.
            'data-[swiping]:transition-none',
            containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </BaseDrawer.Popup>
      </BaseDrawer.Viewport>
    </BaseDrawer.Portal>
  );
}

export function DrawerTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseDrawer.Title>) {
  return <BaseDrawer.Title className={cn('text-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-tight', className)} {...props} />;
}

export function DrawerDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseDrawer.Description>) {
  return <BaseDrawer.Description className={cn('text-sm text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

## Fieldset (`fieldset`)

Fieldset built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add fieldset`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/fieldset.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Fieldset as BaseFieldset } from '@base-ui/react/fieldset';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

const fieldsetVariants = cva('relative flex flex-col gap-4 p-4', {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      // `pt-6` leaves room for the legend, which sits on the top border line.
      default: 'border border-border pt-6',
      ghost: 'border-none bg-transparent'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    variant: 'default'
  }
});

export interface FieldsetProps
  extends React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseFieldset.Root>,
    VariantProps<typeof fieldsetVariants>,
    ContainerRadiusProps {}

export function Fieldset({ className, variant, radius, ...props }: FieldsetProps) {
  return (
    <BaseFieldset.Root
      className={cn(fieldsetVariants({ variant }), containerRadiusVariants({ radius }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

/**
 * Sits astride the fieldset's top border, interrupting it — the native `<legend>`
 * look. Base UI renders this part as a `<div>`, and a `<div>` gets none of the
 * browser's legend behaviour, so the effect is built here: pull it up onto the
 * border line and paint the page background behind it to punch out the gap.
 *
 * The background must match whatever the fieldset sits on. Override it (e.g.
 * `className="bg-card"`) when the surface underneath isn't `--background`.
 */
export function FieldsetLegend({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseFieldset.Legend>) {
  return (
    <BaseFieldset.Legend
      className={cn(
        'absolute -top-[0.6875rem] left-3 bg-background px-1.5',
        'text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-foreground',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { fieldsetVariants };
````

## Menu (`menu`)

Menu built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add menu`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/menu.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Menu as BaseMenu } from '@base-ui/react/menu';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants, contentRadiusStyle, NESTED_RADIUS } from '@/lib/utils';

export const Menu = BaseMenu.Root;
export const MenuTrigger = BaseMenu.Trigger;
export const MenuGroup = BaseMenu.Group;
export const SubmenuRoot = BaseMenu.SubmenuRoot;

export function MenuContent({
  className,
  children,
  sideOffset = 6,
  radius,
  style,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseMenu.Popup> & { sideOffset?: number } & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender();

  return (
    <BaseMenu.Portal>
      <BaseMenu.Positioner sideOffset={sideOffset} className="z-50 outline-none">
        <BaseMenu.Popup
          style={{ ...contentRadiusStyle(radius), ...style }}
          className={cn(
            'min-w-40 border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_var(--color-foreground)] outline-none',
            // Unfold from the trigger's edge instead of the popup's centre.
            '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
            containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </BaseMenu.Popup>
      </BaseMenu.Positioner>
    </BaseMenu.Portal>
  );
}

const itemClasses = cn(
  'flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none',
  NESTED_RADIUS,
  'data-[highlighted]:bg-foreground data-[highlighted]:text-background',
  'data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-40'
);

export function MenuItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseMenu.Item>) {
  return <BaseMenu.Item className={cn(itemClasses, className)} {...props} />;
}

export function MenuGroupLabel({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseMenu.GroupLabel>) {
  return (
    <BaseMenu.GroupLabel
      className={cn('px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function MenuSeparator({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return <div className={cn('-mx-1 my-1 h-px bg-border', className)} {...props} />;
}

export function MenuSubmenuTrigger({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseMenu.SubmenuTrigger>) {
  return (
    <BaseMenu.SubmenuTrigger className={cn(itemClasses, 'justify-between', className)} {...props}>
      {children}
      {/* Signals that this item opens a submenu rather than performing an action. */}
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 16 16"
        className="size-3.5 shrink-0"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth={2}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4" />
      </svg>
    </BaseMenu.SubmenuTrigger>
  );
}
````

## Navigation Menu (`navigation-menu`)

Navigation Menu built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add navigation-menu`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/navigation-menu.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { NavigationMenu as BaseNavigationMenu } from '@base-ui/react/navigation-menu';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

export function NavigationMenu({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Root> & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender({ scale: 0.98, offset: 6 });

  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Root className={cn('relative', className)} {...props}>
      {children}
      <BaseNavigationMenu.Portal>
        <BaseNavigationMenu.Positioner className="z-50" sideOffset={8}>
          <BaseNavigationMenu.Popup
            className={cn(
              'border border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_var(--color-foreground)] outline-none',
              // Base UI measures each panel and publishes the target box as CSS
              // variables (`auto` while a single panel is open, pixel values while
              // switching). Transitioning them is what makes the popup morph
              // between items of different sizes instead of snapping. Motion owns
              // opacity and transform for the enter/exit, so the two never contend
              // for the same properties.
              'h-[var(--popup-height)] w-[var(--popup-width)] overflow-hidden',
              'transition-[width,height] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none',
              '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
              containerRadiusVariants({ radius })
            )}
            render={renderPopup}
          >
            <BaseNavigationMenu.Viewport />
          </BaseNavigationMenu.Popup>
        </BaseNavigationMenu.Positioner>
      </BaseNavigationMenu.Portal>
    </BaseNavigationMenu.Root>
  );
}

export function NavigationMenuList({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.List>) {
  return <BaseNavigationMenu.List className={cn('flex items-center gap-1', className)} {...props} />;
}

export const NavigationMenuItem = BaseNavigationMenu.Item;

export function NavigationMenuTrigger({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Trigger
      className={cn(
        'px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-wide outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function NavigationMenuContent({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Content>) {
  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Content
      className={cn(
        'w-max',
        // Panels cross-fade in the direction the user moved along the menu bar.
        'transition-[opacity,transform] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)]',
        'data-[starting-style]:opacity-0 data-[ending-style]:opacity-0',
        'data-[activation-direction=left]:data-[starting-style]:-translate-x-1/4',
        'data-[activation-direction=right]:data-[starting-style]:translate-x-1/4',
        'data-[activation-direction=left]:data-[ending-style]:translate-x-1/4',
        'data-[activation-direction=right]:data-[ending-style]:-translate-x-1/4',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function NavigationMenuLink({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Link>) {
  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Link
      className={cn('block px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none hover:bg-muted focus-visible:bg-muted', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
````

## Number Field (`number-field`)

Number Field built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add number-field`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/number-field.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { NumberField as BaseNumberField } from '@base-ui/react/number-field';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { cn, type RadiusProps, radiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

export function NumberField({
  className,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNumberField.Root> & RadiusProps) {
  return (
    <BaseNumberField.Root className={cn('inline-flex flex-col gap-1', className)} {...props}>
      <BaseNumberField.Group
        className={cn(
          'flex h-10 items-stretch overflow-hidden border border-input bg-background',
          radiusVariants({ radius })
        )}
      >
        <BaseNumberField.Decrement className="flex w-9 items-center justify-center border-r border-border text-lg outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-inset">
          −
        </BaseNumberField.Decrement>
        <BaseNumberField.Input className="w-16 bg-transparent px-2 text-center text-sm tabular-nums outline-none" />
        <BaseNumberField.Increment className="flex w-9 items-center justify-center border-l border-border text-lg outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-inset">
          +
        </BaseNumberField.Increment>
      </BaseNumberField.Group>
    </BaseNumberField.Root>
  );
}
````

import { OTPField as BaseOTPField } from '@base-ui/react/otp-field';

## Popover (`popover`)

Popover built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add popover`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/popover.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Popover as BasePopover } from '@base-ui/react/popover';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants, type ShadowProps, shadowVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

export const Popover = BasePopover.Root;
export const PopoverTrigger = BasePopover.Trigger;
export const PopoverClose = BasePopover.Close;

export function PopoverContent({
  className,
  children,
  sideOffset = 8,
  radius,
  shadow,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BasePopover.Popup> & { sideOffset?: number } & ContainerRadiusProps & ShadowProps) {
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender();

  return (
    <BasePopover.Portal>
      <BasePopover.Positioner sideOffset={sideOffset} className="z-50">
        <BasePopover.Popup
          className={cn(
            'w-72 border border-border bg-popover p-3 text-popover-foreground outline-none',
            shadowVariants({ shadow }),
            // Grow out of the anchor rather than the popup's own centre.
            '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
            containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          <BasePopover.Arrow
            className={cn(
              'size-2.5 rotate-45 border border-border bg-popover',
              'data-[side=top]:bottom-[-5px] data-[side=bottom]:top-[-5px]',
              'data-[side=left]:right-[-5px] data-[side=right]:left-[-5px]'
            )}
          />
          {children}
        </BasePopover.Popup>
      </BasePopover.Positioner>
    </BasePopover.Portal>
  );
}

export function PopoverTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BasePopover.Title>) {
  return <BasePopover.Title className={cn('text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide', className)} {...props} />;
}

export function PopoverDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BasePopover.Description>) {
  return <BasePopover.Description className={cn('text-sm text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

## Progress (`progress`)

Progress built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add progress`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/progress.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Progress as BaseProgress } from '@base-ui/react/progress';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { cn, type RadiusProps, radiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

export function Progress({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseProgress.Root> & RadiusProps) {
  return (
    <BaseProgress.Root className={cn('flex w-full flex-col gap-1', className)} {...props}>
      <BaseProgress.Track
        className={cn('h-2 w-full overflow-hidden border border-border bg-background', radiusVariants({ radius }))}
      >
        {/*
          Width stays in CSS: Base UI writes the filled width as an inline style
          from the current value, and a transition on that property is what makes
          value changes glide instead of jumping. Motion would need to own the
          width to animate it, and it has no access to the value.
        */}
        <BaseProgress.Indicator
          className={cn(
            'h-full bg-primary',
            'transition-[width] duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)]',
            'data-[indeterminate]:w-1/3 data-[indeterminate]:animate-[progress-indeterminate_1.2s_ease-in-out_infinite]'
          )}
        />
      </BaseProgress.Track>
      {children}
    </BaseProgress.Root>
  );
}

export function ProgressLabel({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseProgress.Label>) {
  return (
    <BaseProgress.Label
      className={cn('text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function ProgressValue({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseProgress.Value>) {
  return <BaseProgress.Value className={cn('text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

## Radio Group (`radio-group`)

Radio Group built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add radio-group`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/radio-group.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Radio as BaseRadio } from '@base-ui/react/radio';
import { RadioGroup as BaseRadioGroup } from '@base-ui/react/radio-group';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { type HTMLMotionProps, motion } from 'motion/react';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useControlTransition } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const radioGroupVariants = cva('flex gap-2', {
  variants: {
    orientation: {
      vertical: 'flex-col',
      horizontal: 'flex-row'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    orientation: 'vertical'
  }
});

export interface RadioGroupProps
  extends React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseRadioGroup>,
    VariantProps<typeof radioGroupVariants> {}

export function RadioGroup({ className, orientation, ...props }: RadioGroupProps) {
  return <BaseRadioGroup className={cn(radioGroupVariants({ orientation }), className)} {...props} />;
}

export function RadioGroupItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseRadio.Root>) {
  const transition = useControlTransition();

  return (
    <BaseRadio.Root
      className={cn(
        'flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-input bg-background outline-none transition-colors',
        'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        'data-[checked]:border-primary',
        'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {/* `keepMounted` so the dot can scale away as well as in — see checkbox.tsx. */}
      <BaseRadio.Indicator
        keepMounted
        className="size-2.5 rounded-full bg-primary"
        render={(indicatorProps, state) => (
          <motion.span
            {...(indicatorProps as HTMLMotionProps<'span'>)}
            initial={false}
            animate={{ opacity: state.checked ? 1 : 0, scale: state.checked ? 1 : 0 }}
            transition={transition}
          />
        )}
      />
    </BaseRadio.Root>
  );
}

export { radioGroupVariants };
````

## Scroll Area (`scroll-area`)

Scroll Area built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add scroll-area`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/scroll-area.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { ScrollArea as BaseScrollArea } from '@base-ui/react/scroll-area';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { type ContainerRadiusProps, cn, containerRadiusVariants } from '@/lib/utils';

export function ScrollArea({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseScrollArea.Root> & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  return (
    <BaseScrollArea.Root
      className={cn('relative overflow-hidden', containerRadiusVariants({ radius }), className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <BaseScrollArea.Viewport className="size-full overscroll-contain outline-none">
        {children}
      </BaseScrollArea.Viewport>
      {/*
        Scrollbars rest invisible and fade in while the pointer is over the area
        or the user is scrolling. Base UI reports both as data attributes, so this
        is a CSS transition rather than Motion — there's no mount/unmount to
        coordinate, and it keeps the scroll path free of React work.
      */}
      <BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar
        orientation="vertical"
        className={cn(
          'flex w-2 touch-none select-none border-l border-border p-0.5',
          'opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out',
          'data-[hovering]:opacity-100 data-[scrolling]:opacity-100'
        )}
      >
        <BaseScrollArea.Thumb className="w-full bg-muted-foreground/60" />
      </BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar>
      <BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar
        orientation="horizontal"
        className={cn(
          'flex h-2 touch-none select-none border-t border-border p-0.5',
          'opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out',
          'data-[hovering]:opacity-100 data-[scrolling]:opacity-100'
        )}
      >
        <BaseScrollArea.Thumb className="h-full bg-muted-foreground/60" />
      </BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar>
      <BaseScrollArea.Corner />
    </BaseScrollArea.Root>
  );
}
````

## Select (`select`)

Select built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add select`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/select.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Select as BaseSelect } from '@base-ui/react/select';
import type * as React from 'react';

import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import {
  type ContainerRadiusProps,
  cn,
  containerRadiusVariants,
  contentRadiusStyle,
  NESTED_RADIUS,
  type RadiusProps,
  radiusVariants
} from '@/lib/utils';

export const Select = BaseSelect.Root;
export const SelectValue = BaseSelect.Value;

export function SelectTrigger({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSelect.Trigger> & RadiusProps) {
  return (
    <BaseSelect.Trigger
      className={cn(
        'flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground outline-none',
        'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        radiusVariants({ radius }),
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <BaseSelect.Icon className="text-muted-foreground">▾</BaseSelect.Icon>
    </BaseSelect.Trigger>
  );
}

export function SelectContent({
  className,
  children,
  radius,
  style,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSelect.Popup> & ContainerRadiusProps) {
  // Unlike other popups, Select stays mounted after the first interaction. The
  // same open-state-driven animation covers both cases — the first open plays
  // `initial`, later ones animate between the two variants.
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender();

  return (
    <BaseSelect.Portal>
      <BaseSelect.Positioner sideOffset={4} className="z-50">
        <BaseSelect.Popup
          // Publishes `--content-radius` so items can stay concentric with the popup.
          style={{ ...contentRadiusStyle(radius), ...style }}
          className={cn(
            'min-w-[var(--anchor-width)] border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_var(--color-foreground)] outline-none',
            '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
            containerRadiusVariants({ radius }),
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </BaseSelect.Popup>
      </BaseSelect.Positioner>
    </BaseSelect.Portal>
  );
}

export function SelectItem({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSelect.Item>) {
  return (
    <BaseSelect.Item
      className={cn(
        'flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none select-none',
        NESTED_RADIUS,
        'data-[highlighted]:bg-foreground data-[highlighted]:text-background',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <BaseSelect.ItemText>{children}</BaseSelect.ItemText>
      <BaseSelect.ItemIndicator>✓</BaseSelect.ItemIndicator>
    </BaseSelect.Item>
  );
}
````
